checks.integrity: R34/R35/R37 analysis and preparation, held-contact bridge, dock rendering and full-gap crossfader geometry match the baseline.
checks.review: Self-review under the project rule against parallel agents.

behaviour: A dedicated 44-point divider lane resizes both retained decks with direct vertical travel.
Release keeps the chosen proportion per orientation for the session. Library changes do not overwrite it.
Cancellation restores the previous split. Viewport change and scene interruption cancel unfinished resizing.
Both decks retain a padded 44-point artwork/expansion target, A/B label and overview at the extremes.
Double-tap restores equal sizes. Accessibility adjustment changes A height in 44-point steps.
Overview contacts now retain their contact space and cancel explicitly when the track changes.
The library maximum reserves 148 points for two 52-point compact decks and their 44-point divider.
limits: Physical multitouch, compact strips, effect menus and clean audio need Erik acceptance.
Size memory lasts for the session and is separate for portrait and landscape.
Unsupported small windows return bounded geometry but are not accepted two-deck layouts.
